items.source:
An interface that represents metadata associated with the results of a moderation
generation process. This interface extends the ResultMetadata interface, which provides
general information about the results generated by an AI model.
items.translation: 一个表示与审核生成过程结果相关的元数据的接口。该接口扩展了 ResultMetadata 接口，后者提供了关于 AI 模型生成结果的通用信息。
